name: Suzie Kondi
band_note: for ruling, 14 Oct: its only sweater is a $2,295 made-to-order hand-knit, not a staple; seated on the $325 shirt entry beside $295 track pants (thread proposal)
why: Velour and cashmere tracksuit sweatshirts and pants plus knits and shirts, about $295 a piece in velour, sold through its own stores, website and independent boutiques.

quote.q: Suzie Kondi isn't just a clothing line—it's a place, it's a feeling, it's a lifestyle, and it's an attitude.

doors.note: US: 2 own doors — New York City, 15 Orchard Street, 10002 (daily), and Amagansett, 137 Main Street, 11930 (Thursday–Monday). A separate page offers shopping appointments in NYC. Stockists by state are retailers. New York label.

fibre.sample: stratified sample of 80 across 5 product types (Shorts, Pants, Blouse, Tank Top, Vest folded into Bottoms/Top), proportional; 226 model-fabric styles from 789 c

craft_evidence.mills: no ('Italian cashmere' and 'Sea Island cotton' named as cloth, no mill)
craft_evidence.madein: 99% (79 of 80: Los Angeles 32, India 22, New York 15 incl. one 'hand knit in New York City', Italy 5, Peru 4, Portugal 1
craft_evidence.heritage: placed — launched 2018, New York; founder grew up in her mother's fabric store in Australia
craft_evidence.process: thin — 'garment dying process' on velour and terry care lines; 'hand-knitted cashmere' in some descriptions
craft_evidence.reasoning: Nearly every product page names a city or country, and the velour and terry tracksuits (40% of the sample) are made in Los Angeles while cashmere is made or hand-knit in New York City. No workshop, knitter or mill is named and there is no process page, so it's a 2.
